result.note: Tested the scale and cause of solar curtailment in April to June 2026, a renewable energy and grid infrastructure theme.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about solar power curtailment in India between April and June 2026, as reported in July 2026:
items: Roughly a quarter of India's solar output was wasted during the period.
The losses arose because solar generation fell short of the capacity of available transmission lines.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: About 11% of solar output, over 8,000 GWh, was wasted, not a quarter. The cause was the reverse of statement 2: generation outpaced the grid lines needed to carry it, so transmission bottlenecks forced the losses.
questions.source: Transmission bottlenecks wasted 11% of India's solar output between April and June, over 8,000 GWh, as generation outpaced the grid lines needed to carry it.
